services.title: Lawn care and mowing
services.body: Lawns are cut, edged and cleaned up on a schedule so the yard never gets ahead of you.
services.alt: Drone view of a solar-panelled roof and a newly laid paver patio, with crew mixing at a wheelbarrow on the lawn.

evidence.text: Crew setting new white vinyl fence panels to a string line along an open trench, spades and tool bags on the grass.

services.title: Mulch and bed work
services.body: Beds are cleaned out, edged and mulched, and plantings are set where they will actually grow.
services.alt: Worker in a bucket hat kneeling to tap a charcoal coping stone into place on a new garden wall.

evidence.text: Front of a brick and vinyl-sided house with the foundation bed cleared and edged and a planted urn beside the step.

services.title: Hardscape, patios and walkways
services.body: Base is compacted and screeded before a single paver or block goes down, which is why it stays level.
services.alt: Two crew members at a wheelbarrow behind a long charcoal block wall being built out along a fence line.

evidence.text: Timber pergola lit with warm string lights at dusk, white drapes tied back around a wicker patio seating set.

services.title: Sod, seeding and grading
services.body: The ground is graded and prepped first, then sodded or seeded so the new lawn takes instead of washing out.
services.alt: Ground level deck being framed against dark grey siding with lumber and power tools on the subframe.

evidence.text: Large heap of dark screened topsoil tipped onto a driveway ready to be barrowed round.

services.title: Drainage
services.body: Water is given somewhere to go, with pipe and grade set so it leaves the house instead of pooling against it.
services.alt: Paver patio going down over a compacted base beside a block plinth, with tools and cut pieces to one side.

evidence.text: Worker kneeling in a trench connecting a run of black corrugated drainage pipe across a lawn.

reviews_h2: Straight from the people who called us

reviews.author: Matthew Middleton
reviews.text: Dom and his team did an excellent job on our patio and steps. Dom provided good aesthetic suggestions and the work was done promptly. Most importantly, Dom was a great communicator throughout the process, responding quickly to our many questions and keeping us updated throughout the project.

reviews.author: Dominique Wise
reviews.text: My wife and I had an amazing experience with this company. To see our ideas come to life and the beauty of our home add a luxury spark to our cul-de-sac is amazing. Thank you again and we are very much appreciated.

reviews.author: Uzair Ali
reviews.text: Working with Dom has been a great experience from the start. He takes the time to explain not just what he's recommending, but why it's the right way to do it, which immediately gave me confidence in his knowledge and integrity. I hired him for my front landscaping and outdoor lighting, and he was thorough, reasonably priced, accommodating, and easy to work with throughout the process. When another project unexpectedly came up at one of my other properties, a concrete slab replacement, Dom went above and beyond by making time on a Sunday. He listened to my concerns when I arrived, addressed every one of them, and made sure the job was completed properly. It's hard to find contractors who genuinely care about doing things the right way instead of just getting the job done. Based on my experience so far, I have complete confidence in Dom and am looking forward to working with him on my larger hardscaping project.

reviews.author: Virginia Bellamy
reviews.text: A part of my yard was a total mess I just couldn't grow any grass, I found Beautified Design & Build online and spoke to Dom he said no problem (I'll get your grass growing) few days later the workers were at work in my yard, I started seeing grass growing a week an half later. Thank you!!!

reviews.author: Tom Paget
reviews.text: Dom is professional and super efficient.Highly recommend his services to anyone in need of landscaping.

reviews.author: Corintha Harris
reviews.text: I had a fence put up. Dom and crew did a beautiful job. I am very very pleased with the job. They are very professional, and polite an understanding to your needs answering all your questions. I will definitely be using this company again for future jobs.

reviews.author: Patrice Clark
reviews.text: Beautified Design & Build did an amazing job installing my white vinyl fence. The owner was professional, knowledgeable and timely. I highly recommend this company. I am very happy with the work and how quickly it was installed.

reviews.author: anilrenu agarwal
reviews.text: Dom did some concrete pavement work for us. Did a really good job. I would recommend him for any such works. He is good to communicate as well.

reviews.author: Dave Sutter
reviews.text: Dom did a great job removing shrub stumps for me. He was very respectful of my property. Highly recommended!

reviews.author: Jarret Bauer
reviews.text: Dom and his team did a fantastic job with our new patio. His communication was great throughout the entire process. Once we committed to the job, the work was done within 2 weeks. His team arrived early every morning. We are extremely excited about our new outside space. The best part, the labor is guaranteed for life just in case any issues come up down the road. I recommend Beautified Design for all your outdoor needs!

reviews.author: Mr Cookie Monster
reviews.text: DO NOT USE. Dom is sketchy and kept demanding more money after we agreed on terms he only did a fraction of the work and he received over 100% of the agreed on payment then threatened me and my family. Also threatened to come to my property and destroy all of the 20 pavers he laid. I paid for materials and that’s all he brought was 20 pavers instead of the 600+ paver needed for the job

reviews.author: Lisa Rotsides
reviews.text: Dom and his crew were great - they installed new 6’ vinyl fencing on my property and removed my old broken fence. They were on time, quick, left the yard clean, passed all inspections timely and answered any and all concerns I had- this process was painless

reviews.author: Nicole Bethea
reviews.text: Today, Dom and his crew fixed the front of my house, particularly my flowerbeds. His service was exemplary! His attention to detail was so refreshing! If you are in need of a professional, kind, and detailed landscaper, Beautified Landscaping is for YOU! I was so impressed that I am booking this company for another job in the spring ASAP!!! Checkout my before and after pictures!!

reviews.author: CBC South Jersey
reviews.text: Beautified Design & Build has worked with Calvary Baptist Church in Beverly, NJ for several years, and Dominique has consistently demonstrated professional, prompt and excellent service. I highly recommend him for any role that demands nothing short of superior workmanship. Thank you again for all you do for our church, you are truly appreciated.

reviews.author: Tracey Rossi
reviews.text: We called needing mulch done. Dom came out with his crew and got the job done the same week. Everything looks beautiful and we have received so many compliments on their work.

reviews.author: Beizy
reviews.text: From the start, Dom & his team were responsive, helpful and professional--but also enjoyable to work with, which is a rare quality these days. He took the time to address my needs and questions & executed a polished final product, within a very reasonable timeframe. I know I will be coming back in the future (in fact, we're already on project #2!) Book these guys, you won't regret it.

reviews.author: Greg Madia
reviews.text: After having three months to complete a landscaping job, and paying them over 80% of the bill, we told them their services were no longer needed to complete the job. They came back to the property and proceeded to dump this debris from the job site at the end of the driveway. Totally unprofessional and totally unacceptable behavior from them, besides the fact that dumping like this is illegal. Don’t hire them for anything.I thought he was a good guy and wanted to see him succeed with his company, but this is beyond low.

reviews.author: Dayna M
reviews.text: Beautified Design & Build added a paved walkway next to my driveway. It looks amazing! Dom helped me choose pavers that would look best for my home, and the crew was very courteous and professional as well. I'll definitely call them again for future projects.

reviews.author: Alejandra Swan
reviews.text: Very good crew, friendly, understanding and willing to work with the customer’s needs. The crew was on time and communicated well regarding any and all project updates.

reviews.author: Nichole
reviews.text: Dom does excellent work, he is a pleasure to work with, his prices are reasonable, and he is fast! I will definitely use his services for future projects and I would absolutely recommend him to others. Thank you Dom!!!

reviews.author: Racquel Angelina
reviews.text: Dom and his team are so great. He’s very responsive, quick and will make sure your needs get met. I wanted these metals away in the back of my house and he got it done asap. They do an amazing job and take pride in their work. I will be continuing to use his services and referring him to all my friends and family!!

reviews.author: Don Sylvester
reviews.text: I am so, so disappointed in this business!!!! They did work for me last year and guaranteed it! They just replaced my existing stockade wood fence. Many boards were rotten or decayed. I contacted the owner at the beginning of April and asked if he could fix a few things I found weren't quite right. He said, "sure I'll come by and we can make it right"! Here it is a MONTH later and nothing has been done!!! I'm terrible at picking contractor's. In my phone I have 5 text messages stating they would be out! Yet! They have not been!!! Don't bother now!!! I WOULD NEVER RECOMMEND THIS BUSINESS TO ANYONE!!!! EVER!!! YOUR WORD IS USELESS!!! YOUR GUARANTEE IS USELESS!!!

reviews.author: James Taylor
reviews.text: Phenomenal job, above and beyond on my retaining wall repair. Brought it back to life. Will be using them for future projects.

reviews.author: Mr.D. Weikel
reviews.text: Excellent work!! The crew came out , installed fence the way I wanted it, and left the area clean.. Professional company..

reviews.author: A Banks
reviews.text: I'm extremely happy with the beautiful job that Dom and his team at Beautified Design & Build did in my backyard. I contacted Dom last summer to get a quote to have a greenhouse built and a paved walkway from the greenhouse to a garden area. Unfortunately, I could not secure the greenhouse to have this done last summer, but I called Dom as soon as I was able to buy the greenhouse and he honored his quote from last year! I also made some changes to the plan on the second day...and they were able to accommodate my requests, with a smile! Dom and his team were a pleasure to work with! I highly recommend them for anything you need to beautify your outdoor space!

reviews.author: Mikhail Wisdom
reviews.text: Was in search of good landscaping company, and luckily came across Dom and his crew. After meeting with Dom and explaining what I was looking for he immediately understood the project and was very responsive in getting the job started. Dom was very professional and has been a pleasure to work with so far, him and his crew works fast and the communication has been nothing short of excellent. I plan on working with Dom and his crew exclusively to get a lot more project done.

reviews.author: Bridget Tucker
reviews.text: I loved my experience with Dom ( Beautified Landscaping). I was so impressed with my first encounter with him. He came dressed very professional and business like. We discussed what I wanted . He understood and completed the task. I valued his inputs. He is very knowledgeable. I love the fact that he is hands on. He was on time and kept me informed. This was a great experience. I’m so happy with the outcome. I woke up and just cried!!! Looking at the completed project. I never imagined that my front yard would look this beautiful. Thank you Dom!!!!

reviews.author: AG Counsel
reviews.text: Dom and his crew did a phenomenal job! I had a very precise vision of what I wanted, and they brought that vision to life, executing it flawlessly. I could not be more satisfied!

reviews.author: Meghin Stanton
reviews.text: My father is selling his house and we were referred to use Dom, Beautified landscaping, to complete the project. We were blown away by Dom and his team with their landscaping design, work ethic, professionalism, and communication. He listened to everything we wanted for our new outdoor spaces and delivered above our expectations. I have never seen my dads house look as good as it does now! They did an unbelievable job and I highly suggest you utilize Beautified Landscaping for your next outdoor landscaping project!

reviews.author: Kyle Morrison
reviews.text: Dom and his crew did great work for a great value. Couldn’t be happier. Everything was timely and professional from getting the estimate, scheduling the job, and the work getting done. Will definitely be using Beautified Landscaping in the future, and recommend to anyone who wants great landscaping work done to their home.

reviews.author: Bryan Watkins
reviews.text: I was very impressed with the quality of service that Dom provided. Not only did he preform the tasks that we contracted him to do he actually did extra things unsolicited. Dom and his crew went above and beyond my expectations. I would highly recommend his company to anyone looking for landscaping work.

reviews.author: Ashley Bolds
reviews.text: I was really impressed by this company. They were extremely professional, friendly, on time, and time efficient. Their quality of work was great, they take the time to make sure they know what your expectations are before beginning your project, check in to make sure you are satisfied with the work during the process, and make sure the final results are to your satisfaction. I had my yard graded, rocks removed, cleaned up, and seeded. The after results are terrific. If you are in the Burlington County area, I definitely recommend Beautified Landscaping.

reviews.author: Ben Lutz
reviews.text: Dom was great, open to suggestions to make sure I was happy with the design. Dom, Ryan and the rest of the crew were clean and communicative and made sure to address any concerns. I'm happy with the result and would use them again!

reviews.author: Janos Vajda
reviews.text: Dom and his team installed downspout drainage, a stone creek bed, French and surface drains, and yard grading to help with water issues in our yard. It was a big job and Dom was a pleasure to work with through the entire process. Great communication, responsiveness, and attention to detail. Dom stands behind his work and came back to fix an issue that we didn't realize until weeks later and was happy to do so.

reviews.author: Brittnee Smith
reviews.text: I found this company on a Facebook group and called right away. I got a response right away, and a quote within days. My quote was fair and affordable and Dom and Jenn were both pleasant with work with in making our vision come to life. IT GETS BETTER! I really wanted the job done before my birthday and BL made sure to make it happen on time. The team came out and within a few SHORT hours the whole thing was done! The job was FAST and done with EXCELLENCE! I recommend them 100% and will be looking to work with them on our next project which includes a deck and fencing! They do it all!!!

reviews.author: Marisa Guerra
reviews.text: Beautified Landscaping is professional, affordable, and thorough! Dom and his crew regraded our backyard, removed numerous tree stumps, and laid down new top soil and grass seed. They did an excellent job in leveling out the yard and followed up with us to ensure our satisfaction. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Jake Olsen
reviews.text: Dom and his crew did great work! They took our vision and made it a reality. Great communication and timelines throughout the whole project. Reasonably priced and offer financing as well. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Rhani Ellis
reviews.text: Dom and his team at Beautified Landscaping are the best! I can’t say enough good things about them. They have done three projects for me so far. They come when they say they will and do great work. They are also very responsive to all requests. Very satisfied customer here!

reviews.author: Michael Stinson
reviews.text: I am very pleased with this company. The work was done as promised in a timely manner. Dom was responsive and courteous. Even the billing and payment options are professionally done. Our home is in good hands now with Beautified Landscaping, LLC.

reviews.author: Christina Loguidice
reviews.text: We had an above-ground pool installed during the pandemic. Seems like it would be a simple task, but the whole process was a nightmare, except for Dom and his team turning the unsightly trenches we were left with into a lovely area that now feels like a retreat. I can't emphasize enough how difficult it is to find a landscaper capable of landscaping around an above ground pool, especially in a yard that is sloped. Unlike other landscapers we contacted, Dom was always very responsive, open to suggestions/collaboration, and flexible. He was also able to do the work within days of us receiving his very fair estimate. This was greatly appreciated because our pool pump was at the top of one of the trenches that was starting to erode because of the rain storms. We highly recommend this company and plan to use them for future projects.

reviews.author: Dana M
reviews.text: I was referred to Beautified Design & Build LLC by a friend and she was not wrong. Dom was professional every step of the process as he installed my fence in a heat wave. He answered all of my questions and eased any concerns I may have had. I’m very pleased.

reviews.author: John Nolan
reviews.text: I met Dom and gave me an estimate for fixing my outdoor lighting and he spent time diagnosing the situation and advised me what needed to be done. I am very happy with his service so far and I am sure I will be with the end result. very nice professional man.

reviews.author: Erika Solomon
reviews.text: Everyone was nice. Owner highly professional. The team was great and timely. Reasonable price for my budget. Needed hedges pulled out and learned they alsk tear down sheds. Had that done and hauled away. Great communication and pricing. Will use again for future projects.

reviews.author: Grace Lazarraga
reviews.text: Our front yard and side yard turned sophisticated and beautiful after Dom and his crew did their excellent job. Dom is very professional and his team were very focused in their job.

Thank you from a loyal happy customer

reviews.author: Damir Abdurakhimov
reviews.text: ***AVOID*** A very unprofessional contractor that botched my fencing project. We were scheduled to start at 9am but they showed up in the afternoon, and when they showed up they had no idea what they were doing. One of their guys hit my underground line and acted like nothing happened. When asked to fix their mistake Dom responded with "why dont you do it yourself" and passed me the hole digger. Do yourself a favor and avoid this contractor.

reviews.author: wilhelmina bellamy
reviews.text: Beautified, LLC installed landscaping lights in the front and side of our house, and it came out great! It beautifully illuminated the nighttime landscape and made it such a joy to look at. The process was smooth, Domonique communicates and kept us in the loop at every step of the project. With Domonique s leadership perfection is standard. We look forward to working with Domonique and Beautified, LLC again in the future.

reviews.author: Ralph Balsamo
reviews.text: This is the third year we have used Beautified Landscaping for our spring clean-up. Every year I am delighted at how beautiful our yard is when they have completed their magic. I drive into the neighborhood with a huge grin because the yard looks so nice. The hard work that Beautified Landscaping puts in to whip our yard into shape makes their fair pricing even more impressive!

reviews.author: Jenn H
reviews.text: This company was easy to work with and highly recommended. Dom was very respectful and accommodating. I ordered mulch and it was delivered on time. I will definitely use them again.

reviews.author: Kortney Davis
reviews.text: I was very happy with the work done by Beautified Design. They were friendly and professional. Services provided were at a good price. I would highly recommend and will use them again!

reviews.author: Sandie Wright
reviews.text: I can be very indecisive. I realize this can be very annoying but i can't help myself...Dom and his team were very professional, patient, friendly and accommodating. They removed existing plants and shrubs, planted new plants and shrubs and left my yard looking totally BEAUTIFIED! I love my new landscape. I will definitely use him again! I fully recommend him!

reviews.author: felicia pryor
reviews.text: Dom and his crew did a wonderful job on my fence. I would definitely recommend them to anyone. Looking forward to working with them on future projects.

reviews.author: Heather Anuszkiewicz
reviews.text: My back yard was , well... a hot mess, and Beautified came in cleared out the chaos , including vines , shrubs and mess. Thank you for being professional , hard working, landscape magicians! Don't be overwhelmed by overgrowth!! Call Beautified! I highly recommend!

reviews.author: Timothy Johnson
reviews.text: Hey Dom Landscaper Moore. I have had over 20 landscaping companies do projects for my properties and none of them could meet my expectations until I found you on Google. I said that the hell "give this guy a shot" and after you serviced my properties, Winter, Spring, Summer and Fall. I was like "where have you been all my life". I have this one thing to say, if you would have been the glove at OJ"s trial, he would have been guilty. I highly recommend that anyone in need of lawn care including snow removal to atleast consult with him prior to making a decision. I guarantee that you will not only save time and money but misery also. Thanks for the service

reviews.author: Ama
reviews.text: Great customer service, paid very good attention to detail, and the crew was knowledgeable about the work we needed. The process moved very fast and the work was done when they said it would be done, which is very different from some other companies I tried to use. Overall, it was a really good experience and I look forward to working with them in the future!
